entries.title: Narrative question
entries.description: What is happening in the scene?

entries.title: Intent question
entries.description: What is the speaker trying to do?

entries.title: Context question
entries.description: Does the surrounding context change the meaning?

entries.title: Evidence question
entries.description: What exact evidence supports the conclusion?

entries.title: Exception question
entries.description: Is there a documentary, educational, police, or court exception?

entries.title: Cross-scene question
entries.description: Do later scenes confirm or reverse the meaning?

entries.title: False positive question
entries.description: Could this be a harmless mention or a false accusation?
